newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia court releases some Megewati supporters.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia court releases some Megewati supporters.

text.p: An Indonesian court on Wednesday ordered the release of 11 supporters of opposition figure Megawati Sukarnoputri who have been jailed for four months in connection with riots in Jakarta in July, associates said.

It was the first of verdicts due on Wednesday on the fate of 124 supporters of Megawati arrested after the July 27 riots. Her associates said one of the accused was acquitted while 10 others were sentenced to time already served in custody.

The riots, the worst in the Indonesian capital for more than two decades, erupted after police raided the headquarters of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) and evicted supporters of Megawati who had been entrenched inside the building for over a month.
Those jailed, all of whom were Megawati supporters, were accused of disobeying orders to leave the area and assaulting police.
Megawati, the daughter of late founding president Sukarno, was ousted from the PDI leadership in June by a government-backed faction.
She was in the Central Jakarta State Court complex listening to the verdict being read out in another case dealing with her supporters, witnesses said.
